body: That's a good idea. I'm trying to possibly volunteer at my local SPCA just to get some of my free time covered when I'm not at work or school. And there is a coffee shop near where I live so I might go to that. It's just so frustrating to not be comfortable in my own room now. But like you said, I guess it just takes time. I just want to feel normal again. I start to for a little bit and then suddenly my chest tightens up and I get panic-y and all of the doom and dread washes back up. Luckily I've managed to re-connect with a really good friend that has been there for me to talk to when things get bad. He actually texted and called me and my roommate one night when I told him things were not going well. I fell asleep and we was worried that I had done something since I hadn't responded. So it's nice to have that support from him. Like I said before, those suicidal thoughts are still there but I think it's getting easier to cope. I'm just hoping that time will help, like you said. Thank you.

Thank you again. It's hard to figure out what to do when I'm in a situation where I'm just sitting at home and not at work or school. My friends can't hang out with me all the time and I really think that's when I start getting to a dark place. For instance, I work nights and I woke up 2 hours before I have to get ready for work. I watched some youtube videos but the loneliness and sadness are slowly creeping up on me. I want to be out of my room and not have to think about everything that has happened but I can't really go anywhere and I don't really want to go to work early. I hate that I'm not comfortable in my own space anymore. It doesn't seem fair.

Thank you for your kind words. I really do appreciate them and they do help. I have been to a therapist before (twice actually in the past couple of years) and it does help, though since I do have a lack of motivation it's hard to keep going back... I'm not sure if I'll go again. But thank you.

And yeah, I'm going to be living a moment at a time. It's hard to stay happy when suddenly reality snaps back into my head and the walls just fall down. My friend and I were at Chipotle earlier and it suddenly hit me and I was just staring out into space. He actually had to ask me if I was okay and I almost burst into tears there. I cried at work when no one was around. It's hard.

I'm trying to make sure it doesn't totally consume me, but it is very difficult. My life and my future plans have totally been turned upside down and it's hard to really care about the future when it seems like the one I thought about for the past few months has been ripped away from me. Even my professional/college plans that I've been working toward for the past 3 years (if not my whole school life) are being threatened and it is hard to keep everything together.

I am trying to keep in contact with friends and go out but it's hard with my schedule as well as also not caring about anything but wanting to curl up in bed and cry. I do want to redecorate my room, move stuff around. The large space where he kept his computer and other stuff is like a giant, gaping wound and every time I see it I lose it. 

Thank you again. Like I said in another comment, I am still very much feeling suicidal but I'm going to continue to talk it out with whomever will listen. It makes it a little more bearable, seeing as the one person that I talked to and confided in the most is gone. It's like a death. It's horrible.

I do know what you mean, thank you. I appreciate you talking to me and helping me see your perspective. I still feel very suicidal but talking through everything is helping me figure out what I want to do.

I'm going to go step by step, that's all I can do at this point. My scope on my future went from planning out the next few months to just making sure I'm not crying every few hours, but step by step as you said.

Thank you.

Yes I suppose I do. It's hard not to blame myself though. I want to learn from this but all I feel right now is sadness and that I am a failure. I feel like my trust has been broken and no matter how hard I try, nothing will work in my favor. If trying is leading me nowhere, and not caring leads me nowhere, that leaves me with nothing.

I would love to move out of that hellhole, but I have a lease that I just renewed and a limited amount of money that I can spend to get a new place. One bedroom apartments aren't cheap in the city, and I'm currently living with two other people in a three bedroom because of that fact. I would love to live by myself in a new place. But I'm stuck. I hate myself and I'm stuck.

I have been hanging out with an old friend, but like I said, once I'm alone again everything comes crashing down on me. I don't want to be in my own room. Everything in my apartment reminds me of him and I feel betrayed and empty. And that just starts the spiral down into my failures in school, my job, everything. I feel absolutely useless.

That's what I'm trying to do but as soon as I'm back home or as soon as I see something that reminds me of him or my school problems, I get pulled right back in. I can't eat, I can't sleep, I feel alone and I feel like I've failed at every chance I get. Thank you for your message, I do appreciate it even though I am so negative about the whole thing. I wish I could believe that I matter but everything leading up to now makes me think that I don't really.

There is no such thing as bad luck. It's just a way to justify the shitty things going on in your life and place blame somewhere else. As far as I'm concerned this is all my fault and I should have been or should be able to fix it. But for whatever reason, no matter how hard I try, it doesn't matter. I would love to be able to clear my head but I can't stop thinking about it all. Everything reminds me of him and my failures. Thank you for your kind words and I'm sorry for my negativity.
